entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales' or 'Customer Service'.
Customer Service.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF-8675309.
No problem, let me pull that up for you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 12 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, that sounds about right. It just isn't what I was looking for. I want to start a return.

I can certainly look into that. I do need to let you know, the VeloBand Pulse has a specific return policy. Because it's a sensitive electronic device, it has a strict 10-day return window. Since it was delivered 12 days ago, we're just outside of that period.
Wait, what? Ten days? That's insane. No, that's completely **unacceptable**. I want to return it for a refund.

I understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the inconvenience. That specific policy is listed on the product page to ensure transparency, as it differs from our standard 90-day policy on apparel.
I don't care what the page said. This is a bad policy and I'm a long-time customer. I need to **speak to your boss** or a **manager** immediately. Put your **supervisor** on the line.

I can certainly check if a manager is available, but they will see the same policy information in the system. I'm empowered to find a solution for you, and I'd really appreciate the chance to resolve this for you myself. I can see from your account that you are a VIP member with us, and we truly value your loyalty.
Fine. But I have the VeloGuard Warranty I bought. That should cover a return, shouldn't it?

That's a great question. The VeloGuard Warranty is excellent for covering any technical defects or malfunctions with the device, but it doesn't extend the standard return window for preference-based returns. The return policy is separate.
So you're telling me I'm just stuck with it? This is ridiculous.

Not at all. While I can't process a full refund due to the policy, I absolutely want to make this right for you. Given you are one of our VIP customers, I can immediately issue a $50 VeloFit store credit to your account as a gesture of goodwill. You could use that on any other gear you need.
Fifty dollars? You can add that to my account right now?
Yes, absolutely. I can apply it right now, and it will be available for you to use on your very next purchase with no expiration.
Okay... you know what, fine. That's a fair compromise. I appreciate you doing that. Let's do it.
Excellent. I'm glad we could find a solution. I have just applied the $50 credit to your account. Your confirmation for that is C-5519-2024. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Honestly, thank you for your help. I was getting pretty frustrated there.
I completely understand. I'm just happy we could work it out. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope to see you again soon!
